description: This file implements various linear algebra algorithms for low rank matrices, including functions for approximate basis computation, low-rank SVD, and PCA.

methods.name: get_approximate_basis
methods.description: Computes an approximate basis for a matrix using randomized algorithms based on Halko et al., 2009.

methods.name: svd_lowrank
methods.description: Computes a low-rank approximation of a matrix using randomized SVD based on Halko et al., 2009.

methods.name: _svd_lowrank
methods.description: Internal implementation of the low-rank SVD algorithm.

methods.name: pca_lowrank
methods.description: Performs PCA on a low-rank or sparse matrix, returning approximate SVD components.
